chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Ahmad and Abdullah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mufaddal ibn Mazid, who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said:
I admonish you against two characteristics in which men are ruined: to worship God with falsehood and to give fatwa to people based on what you do not know.

key_terms.بِمَا لَا تَعْلَمُ: based on what you do not know

ai.seo_question: What are the two characteristics that cause men to perish according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifying these two traits as the root of spiritual ruin, linking doctrinal error (attributing falsehood to God) with practical error (issuing fatwas without knowledge). This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on the necessity of *'ilm* (knowledge) and *'adl* (justice) in both belief and legal authority, warning that ignorance in religious rulings leads to the misguidance of the community.
